I've confirmed the pattern. Color 4 in Train 2 functions as a container restored in the output, while other elements outside the container get removed. In Train 3, color 7's shape is a thick hollow square, with intersecting diagonal lines from color 6. The output completely restores the container shape of color 7, and removes elements of color 6 outside of it. It seems the rule applies with the same results!

5. Keep the parts of the lines that lie strictly inside the interior of the container.
